ghaznavid_generals_4 = { # Ghazi Sayyid Salar Mas'ud, born at Satrikh, killed fighting the Hindu kings at Bahraich; his tomb there drew pilgrims of every faith
	name = "Masud"
	dynasty = afghan_salar
	father = ghaznavid_generals_2
	rite = hanafi
	culture = afghan
	trait = faith_warrior
	trait = brave
	trait = zealous
	trait = education_martial_2
	1015.2.4 = {
		birth = yes
	}
	1029.1.1 = {
		employer = 144125
	}
	1033.6.14 = {
		add_trait = saint
		death = {
			death_reason = death_martyrdom
		}
		effect_even_if_dead = {
			pam_canonize_saint_effect = {
				CANONIZER = root
				CANDIDATE = root
				CONSECRATION_PROVINCE = province:3955 # Bahraich, his tomb, the Dargah of Ghazi Miyan
				PRESET = yes
			}
			religion:islam_religion = {
				every_faith = {
					limit = {
						MB_islam_sunni_saint_faith_trigger = yes
						main_rite = { is_rite_enabled = yes }
						NOT = { has_saint_character = root }
					}
					add_saint = { character = root }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

maimonides_1 = { # Moses ben Maimon of Cordoba, physician to Saladin's court at Fustat, author of the Mishneh Torah and the Guide for the Perplexed
	name = "Moshe"
	rite = rabbinism
	culture = sephardi
	trait = education_learning_4
	trait = diligent
	trait = lifestyle_physician
	trait = lifestyle_scholar
	trait = compassionate
	trait = generous
	trait = intellect_good_2
	1135.3.30 = {
		birth = yes
	}
	1178.1.1 = {
		add_trait_xp = {
			trait = lifestyle_physician
			value = {
				integer_range = {
					min = medium_lifestyle_random_xp_low
					max = medium_lifestyle_random_xp_high
				}
			}
		}
	}
	1204.12.12 = {
		add_trait = saint
		death = yes
		effect_even_if_dead = {
			pam_canonize_saint_effect = {
				CANONIZER = root
				CANDIDATE = root
				CONSECRATION_PROVINCE = province:5959 # Tiberias, his tomb, to which his body was carried from Fustat
				PRESET = yes
			}
			religion:judaism_religion = {
				every_faith = {
					limit = {
						MB_judaism_rabbinic_saint_faith_trigger = yes
						main_rite = { is_rite_enabled = yes }
						NOT = { has_saint_character = root }
					}
					add_saint = { character = root }
				}
			}
			if = { # No relics: under Jewish law the dead are not disturbed and no bone is taken from the grave
				limit = {
					title:c_tiberias.holder ?= { faith = { has_saint_character = character:maimonides_1 } }
				}
				title:c_tiberias.holder = {
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:maimonides_1
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:maimonides_1
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:maimonides_1
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:maimonides_1
				}
				set_global_variable = MB_norelic_maimonides_1
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

			death_reason = death_suicide_immolation
		}
		effect_even_if_dead = {
			pam_canonize_saint_effect = {
				CANONIZER = root
				CANDIDATE = root
				CONSECRATION_PROVINCE = province:4388 # Kesh, for his fortress of Sanam, where he burned himself rather than surrender
				PRESET = yes
			}
			religion:zoroastrianism_religion = {
				every_faith = {
					limit = {
						MB_zoroastrianism_khurramite_saint_faith_trigger = yes
						main_rite = { is_rite_enabled = yes }
						NOT = { has_saint_character = root }
					}
					add_saint = { character = root }
				}
			}
			if = { # No relics: the dead are given to the birds and the bones to the ossuary; no part of the body is kept
				limit = {
					title:c_kishsh.holder ?= { faith = { has_saint_character = character:188681 } }
				}
				title:c_kishsh.holder = {
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:188681
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:188681
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:188681
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:188681
				}
				set_global_variable = MB_norelic_188681
			}
		}
	}
}
